name: Notification (web component)
summary: The notification card as a framework-free element with an imperative notify() call: a titled white card with an optional line of detail and one action, in the same bottom-right stack as the toast.
highlights: notify({ title, description, action }) from any handler
Shares the toast's region, announcement and pause
One action button; a click also closes the card
lead: ONE call, notify(), that renders an <aha-notification> into the same <aha-toaster> region as toast(), at the bottom-right of the window. The card matches the antd Notification themed by notification-theme.js value for value: 384 wide, white, radius 8, 20/24 padding, a 16/24 SemiBold ink title, a 14/22 secondary description, an optional 24px status glyph in the default icon colour (never a status hue) and the shared dismiss ✕ on the title's first line. Use it when a toast's one line is not enough: a title plus a sentence, or one action such as Undo. It is announced as "title. description" through the region's live region, never takes focus, pauses with the stack on hover or focus, and leaves after 4.5 seconds unless the duration is 0.
codeNote: notify(options) and notify.success / info / warning / error(options) return { key, close(), update(patch), closed }. Options: { title, description, type, duration (seconds, default 4.5, 0 = sticky), key, action, closeLabel, onClose }. action is { label, onClick(event) }, rendered as one secondary sm aha-button, or your own Node; a click closes the card unless onClick calls event.preventDefault(). A key already on screen updates that card in place. notify.close(key) and notify.closeAll() dismiss. The element also works on its own: <aha-notification heading="…" type="…" duration="0">detail<aha-button slot="action">…</aha-button></aha-notification>.

spec.label: Card
spec.value: white (bg-elevated), 384 wide (never wider than the viewport less 32), radius 8, padding 20 24, gap 12 between the glyph and the text, the antd notification shadow

spec.label: Title
spec.value: 16/24 SemiBold ink (the heading attribute or title option), wraps; the shared ✕ (tertiary icon-only xs aha-button, system-x 16) pinned to its first line, 8 from it, always shown

spec.label: Description
spec.value: 14/22 secondary, 8 under the title; hidden when empty

spec.label: Glyph
spec.value: optional 24px stroke status icon in icon-default; no type, no glyph; never a status hue (Feedback C6)

spec.label: Action
spec.value: slot="action", right-aligned, 12 under the text; one secondary sm aha-button from the action option; a click closes the card

spec.label: Region
spec.value: the shared <aha-toaster> at the bottom-right (see Toast (web component)); notifications and toasts stack together, newest at the bottom

spec.label: Behaviour
spec.value: announced as "title. description" (assertive for an error); never takes focus; hover or focus pauses the stack; Esc on a focused card or the ✕ dismisses it and focus goes back to where it was

props.name: notify(options)
props.desc: Opens a card. Returns { key, close(), update(patch), closed }

props.name: notify.close(key) / closeAll()
props.desc: Dismisses one card or every notification

props.name: heading
props.desc: The title (the title option of notify())

props.name: type
props.desc: The glyph; error is announced assertively. No type, no glyph

props.name: duration
props.desc: Seconds on screen; 0 keeps it until dismissed

props.name: slot="action"
props.desc: One button under the text; hidden when empty

props.name: close
props.desc: Cancelable, composed. detail.source is timeout, close-button, escape, action, overflow or method

props.name: closed
props.desc: Composed. The card has left; the handle's closed promise resolves

whenToUse.when: a titled message with a sentence of detail or one action (Undo, View), from code that cannot reach antd's notification
a React or Vue 3 app that already themes antd with notification-theme.js
the user must decide before going on

opinion.note: One action at most, and never the only way to do it: the card leaves on its own. Title in sentence case, no full stop; the description is a full sentence.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form: a version-pinned CDN import and plain HTML, no build step.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP), on the static sticky plain example with the DS defaults.
